# Beta

Judge liveness by `capability:session-notifications` and elapsed time. Invoke a
sibling skill by name (`capability:invoke-skill`) when the task needs it. The
plain word "agent" and the word "task" appear here on purpose — the lint must
leave ordinary prose alone.

Bindings for your harness: see `../../references/<harness>.md`.
